citations.assessment: The Bavli reports the possession and orphaned nephew relationship. The one who personally appears before Rav Ashi in the narrative is the uncle Ravina.
Ketubot has Ravina ask whether he may take the nephew’s wine with his own. The ship and prospect of sinking explain the question in Heilprin’s paraphrase.
